attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count is explained by per-chunk overhead, separate spatial costs for the initial and subsequent chunks, and quadratic attention work at the bottleneck.

pcvs.name: temporal_chunks
pcvs.rationale: Tracks encoder invocations and per-chunk Python, dispatch, and cache-management overhead.

pcvs.name: spatial_area
pcvs.rationale: Captures spatial work for the initial frame, including convolution padding and normalization.

pcvs.name: subsequent_chunk_area
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional convolution, normalization, and cache-copy work for subsequent four-frame chunks.

pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Captures quadratic spatial attention work at the encoder's compressed resolution.
